🕺 The Ultimate Disco & Dance Floor Legacy 💃

Phase 3: The Funk & Disco Peak

Phase 4: Rock-Disco Crossover

  • I Love Rock and Roll – Joan Jett

  • I Love The Night Life – Alicia Myers

  • I Wanna Be Sedated – Ramones

  • I Will Survive – Gloria Gaynor

  • Instant Replay – Dan Hartman

  • 👉 Relight My Fire – Dan Hartman

  • It’s Only Rock and Roll (But I Like it) – Rolling Stones

  • It’s Raining Men – The Weather Girls

  • It’s Still Rock and Roll to Me – Billy Joel

  • The Joker – Steve Miller Band

  • Jungle Boogie – Kool & the Gang

  • Just Can’t Get Enough – Depeche Mode

Phase 5: Club Classics

  • Knock on Wood – Amii Stewart

  • Ladies Night – Kool & the Gang

  • Last Dance – Donna Summer

  • Le Freak – Chic

  • Let’s Groove – Earth, Wind & Fire

  • 👉 September – Earth, Wind & Fire

  • Macho Man – Village People

  • Mandolay – La Flavour

  • Margaritaville – Jimmy Buffett

  • Mickey – Toni Basil

  • Mony Mony – Billy Idol

  • Night Fever – Bee Gees

Phase 6: The Homestretch

  • Old Time Rock and Roll – Bob Seger

  • Only the Good Die Young – Billy Joel

  • Our Lips Are Sealed – Go-Go’s

  • Paradise by the Dashboard Light – Meat Loaf

  • Play That Funky Music – Wild Cherry

  • Rapper’s Delight – SugarHill Gang

  • Ring My Bell – Anita Ward

  • 👉 Funkytown – Lipps Inc.

  • Rock Lobster – B-52’s

  • Shake Your Booty – KC & the Sunshine Band

  • Shake Your Groove Thing – Peaches & Herb

  • Shame – Evelyn “Champagne” King

  • Shining Star – Earth, Wind & Fire

Phase 7: The Grand Finale

  • You Shook Me All Night Long – AC/DC

  • Should I Stay or Should I Go – The Clash

  • Situation – Yazoo

  • So Many Men, So Little Time – Miguel Brown

  • Start Me Up – Rolling Stones

  • Stayin’ Alive – Bee Gees

  • Superfreak – Rick James

  • Tainted Love – Soft Cell

  • Take Your Time (Do it Right) – S.O.S. Band

  • That’s the Way I Like it – KC & the Sunshine Band

  • 👉 Ladies’ Night – Kool & the Gang (Extended)

  • Time Warp – Rocky Horror Picture Show

  • Turn the Beat Around – Vicki Sue Robinson

  • Upside Down – Diana Ross

  • Walk this Way – Aerosmith / Run-D.M.C.

  • We Are Family – Sister Sledge

  • We Got The Beat – Go-Go’s

  • What I Like About You – The Romantics

  • Whip It – Devo

  • White Lines – Grandmaster Flash

  • Y.M.C.A. – Village People

  • You Dropped a Bomb on Me – Gap Band

  • You Should Be Dancing – Bee Gees

  • You’re the One That I Want – Olivia Newton-John & John Travolta
